description: Three units and a fourth whose extension substream declares 2,000 bytes but the file ends 150 bytes into it.

decode_errors.2112: Packet too short for EXSS frame

skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg's decoder sets the profile itself when it has decoded a frame (dca_core.c, dca_xll.c), and DTS-HD Master Audio or DTS-HD High Resolution Audio only after it has decoded the extension, which the stub components do not allow
skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects the XLL stub, a common header followed by filler, for its missing channel set sub-header (dca_xll.c: 'Invalid XLL sub-header checksum'), and the cut substream is 'too short for EXSS frame' (dca_exss.c)
